title: mollugo flavescens subsp. insularis
intro: Mollugo flavescens subsp. insularis, commonly known as the Island Carpetweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Phyllobacteriaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mollugo flavescens subsp. insularis include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
